REVERA modifications: JavaScript adaptation of Get_A_Sabine, Get_A_Eyring and Get_TR_, by AkuZoft, 2026. Volume comes from REVERA's validated closed envelope instead of a tetrahedral mesh. This version implements only global reverberation, with atmospheric absorption disabled. No SPPS, spatial field, receiver calculations or mesh generator is included.
The unmodified corresponding upstream file and GPL text are distributed with the adaptation. Full upstream source is available at the commit/tag above.
